_about: Curation pass over Master_50State_ESG_Companies_All_Locations.xlsx, sheet 'All Companies (All States)', per summit-launch-spec §5.
Key = 'Company|Facility/Site Name' exactly as in columns B and C. Only rows in a Summit metro are considered.
include: a published, quantified water commitment, ≤160 chars, in the company's own terms, with a working company source.
exclude: the goal text says none was found, the figure is performance not a commitment, the source is not the company's own, or anything uncertain.
Columns J (Product Fit), K (Fit Category), M (Notes) are never read by the build.
verified = date the commitment wording was checked against the source by a person or agent. Re-verify before the event.

Intel Corporation|Ocotillo Campus.commitment: Net positive water by 2030: restore more than 100% of the fresh water Intel consumes.

Salt River Project (SRP)|SRP Headquarter.commitment: By 2035: 30% lower generation-related water-use intensity than 2005, and 5 billion gallons conserved through partnership.

Kimberly-Clark Corporation|World Headqua.commitment: 2030 Ambition: reduce operational water footprint 50% versus 2015 at manufacturing sites in water-stressed areas.

Alphabet Inc. (Google)|New Albany Data C.commitment: Replenish 120% of the freshwater consumed across offices and data centers, on average, by 2030.
Alphabet Inc. (Google)|New Albany Data C.note: Sheet address '1101 Beech Rd SW, New Albany' has no Census street match, so the card drops at build. Needs a confirmed geocodable address for the campus.
